mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_memo (id, workspace_id, title, created_by, visibility, body_html, body_md, file_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{title}, #{createdBy}, #{visibility}, #{bodyHtml}, #{bodyMd}, #{fileId}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update:
UPDATE workspace_memo
title = #{title}, pinned = TRUE, pinned = FALSE, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, body_html = #{bodyHtml}, body_md = #{bodyMd}, file_id = #{fileId}, visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW(),
WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace_memo WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_memo SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace_memo WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, workspace_id, title, created_by, visibility, file_id, pinned, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace_memo WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT left( trim(regexp_replace( regexp_replace( split_part(coalesce(body_md, ''), '](data:', 1), '!\[[^]]*\]?\s*$', '', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')), 180) FROM workspace_memo WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( lower(coalesce(visibility, 'shared')) <> 'private' OR created_by = #{userId} )

SELECT id, workspace_id, title, created_by, visibility, file_id, pinned, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace_memo WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( lower(coalesce(visibility, 'shared')) <> 'private' OR created_by = #{userId} ) AND lower(title) = lower(#{title}) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
